description.value: The King's Head Public House is an iconic Kitsilano neighbourhood pub set in a Tudor-style building constructed in 1897, originally a fish market and beauty parlour before becoming the area's first pub in 1973. Recently fully renovated, it features a modern olde-style interior with live entertainment, locally inspired food, and daily happy hours. It sits on Yew Street close to the Kits Beach waterfront and the Arbutus Greenway, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists exploring Vancouver's west side.
